newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toshiba shares higher on DVD sales report.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba shares higher on DVD sales report.

text.p: Shares in Toshiba Corp were higher in mid-morning Wednesday trade, encouraged by media reports on Japanese consumer electronics markers' plans to start selling digital video disc players (DVD), brokers said.
The shares were up seven yen at 720 yen at 0124 GMT, with a trade volume of 1.039 million shares.
Financial daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said electronics makers including Toshiba, Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd, Hitachi Ltd and Pioneer Electronic Corp plan to start DVD sales in late October.
